<think>

<Goal>
<Outline>1: Count compatible engineer-arrival pairs when the boss arrives in the first hour.</Outline>
<Outline>2: Count compatible engineer-arrival pairs when the boss arrives in the second hour.</Outline>
</Goal>
<Path>1: Measure time in hours after 2:00. If the boss arrives at time b from 0 to 1, both engineers must have arrived in the b by b square. Their arrival difference is automatically at most one hour, so the compatible area is b^2.</Path>
<Path>2: If the boss arrives at time b from 1 to 2, the two engineers must arrive by b and within one hour of one another. In the b by b square, the two excluded corner triangles each have leg b - 1, so compatible area is b^2 - (b - 1)^2 = 2b - 1.</Path>
<Conclusion>For fixed boss time, engineer-pair probability is compatible area divided by 4, and the boss-time density is 1/2. The total probability is (1/8)[integral from 0 to 1 of b^2 db plus integral from 1 to 2 of (2b - 1) db] = (1/8)(1/3 + 2) = 7/24.</Conclusion>
</Parallel>
</think>
Final Answer: 7/24
